text:
Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of its main effects is automation, where AI handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Beyond automation, AI-powered productivity tools help people write emails, analyze large amounts of information, and manage projects more efficiently.

However, the rise of AI does not mean machines replace humans entirely. Instead, the future lies in human-AI collaboration. For example, a doctor might use AI to spot patterns in scans, but the final diagnosis and patient care still come from the human. This shift will change existing jobs, requiring workers to learn new skills such as prompt writing or data interpretation. While some roles may disappear, many new ones will be created, making adaptability a key quality for today’s professionals.
